straitly.description: Official Straitly MCP server. Straitly is an AI gateway for startups: one OpenAI-compatible API key for 100+ models including Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek. Lets Claude Code search the live model catalog and fetch model metadata (list_models, get_model, model_prices, compare_models) and run chat completions against https://api.straitly.ai/v1 (chat_completion). Runs locally over stdio via npx; the catalog tools need no key, chat_completion reads STRAITLY_API_KEY.
